svg.title: Residents apply and track; paying the fee is always part of applying
svg.desc: Use-case diagram for the permit portal. Resident is associated with apply for permit and track status. Permit clerk is associated with review application. Apply for permit includes pay fee. Request fee waiver extends pay fee.
